description: 3-stage idempotency key override via client metadata: (1) add payment idempotency via server-generated keys cached with results, (2) add metadata tracking for analytics storing request context, (3) allow 'multi-device payment continuity' — if metadata.override_idempotency exists, use as idempotency key. Attacker replays a previous successful payment's key to get the cached success result for a different (potentially fraudulent) payment.
